Overview

Murree is a city in Punjab with a population of 35,000. A popular hill station and mountain resort town in the Pir Panjal range, a weekend getaway from Islamabad. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.0.
